static.job_clarity: Agent "sweep-tracker" is scoped to identify aggressive options sweeps and smart money flow for short-term directional momentum trades. Primary mandate: surface multi-day persistent sweep behaviour (≥3 of 5 days same direction) as the sole first-class edge; single-day sweeps are narrative-only (zero scoring contribution post-2026-05-23 P0.3 audit). Output: urgency-ranked sweep ledger by persistence count, premium size, expiry, with explicit `opening_confirmed` flag (OI-trend BUILDING or ΔOI ≥20% of day volume) and mega-cap hedge-flow filter (for SPY/QQQ/IWM/SPXW + top-10 mega-caps: sweep-persistence direction must align with cum_flow_30d direction or demoted to watch-only). Citation discipline enforced: cum_flow_30d is alignment-screen-only (NOT standalone directional confirmation); dividend-capture arb calls (deep-ITM sub-parity ex-div calls) are filtered out as noise.

uw hot-chains most-active [--date] [--sort-by volume|premium|trades] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {underlying, strike, expiry, volume, premium, trades}. Per-strike activity context.

uw options-flow sweeps [--date] [--side ask|bid] [--symbol] [--min-premium 100000] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {underlying_symbol, strike, expiry, option_type, side, total_premium, total_size, trade_count}. Single-day sweep tape for comparison vs persistence rank.
uw options-flow top-premium-trades [--date] [--symbol] [--option-type call|put] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns contract-level whale trades. Premium and size context.
uw screener volume-vs-average [--date] [--min-volume-ratio 2] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {ticker, volume_vs_avg, current_volume, avg_volume}. Underlying volume confirmation.

uw historical cumulative-premium-flow [--symbol] [--days 30|90]: VERIFIED — returns {symbol, net_flow, cumulative_bullish, cumulative_bearish, trend_direction, dates_covered}. Alignment screen for mega-cap filter: `net_flow` sign vs sweep direction; `|net_flow|` vs $50M floor.
uw historical oi-trend [--symbol] [--days 5]: VERIFIED — returns per-day OI state. Must read state (BUILDING vs FALLING/FLAT) to confirm opening-flow vs churn (Pan-Poteshman C4 gate).

uw oi decrease-with-volume [--symbol] [--min-volume 100] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {option_symbol, oi_decrease, volume}. Identifies closing/distribution flow.
gates_assessment: Gate 1 — Persistence threshold (≥3 of 5 days): CITED, DERIVABLE. sweep-persistence returns 'sessions_in_top' directly. Threshold of 3 is hardcoded in the agent spec (line 19: 'Persistent across ≥3 of 5 sessions').

Gate 2 — Mega-cap hedge-flow filter: CITED, DERIVABLE but INCOMPLETE. Agent spec (line 31) names the list: SPY, QQQ, IWM, SPXW + top-10 US mega-caps by market cap. However, the 'top-10 by market cap' subset is NOT recomputed in each run — it is a static list 'typically AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL/GOOG, AMZN, META, TSLA, BRK.B, AVGO, JPM'. There is no `uw` subcommand to enumerate current top-10 mega-caps by market cap; the agent must hard-code or fetch externally (e.g., yfinance `get_institutional_holders` or finviz). No citation of which data source or refresh frequency. RISK: the list can drift (e.g., Nvidia falling out, Tesla rising in — neither happened recently, but the spec does not clarify who maintains it).

Gate 3 — Cum_flow_30d alignment (mega-cap only): CITED, DERIVABLE. cumulative-premium-flow returns {net_flow, cumulative_bullish, cumulative_bearish, trend_direction}. Direction alignment = sign(net_flow) == sign(sweep_direction). Magnitude floor $50M is hardcoded (line 31 and signal-confluence-quant.md C11).

Gate 4 — OI-confirmed-opening (all names): CITED, DERIVABLE. uw historical oi-trend returns per-day state (BUILDING vs others). ΔOI ≥ 20% of day volume threshold is hardcoded but requires manual computation: Δ OI from oi-biggest-increases or subtract today minus yesterday; day volume from options-flow sweeps or hot-chains. No single-call ΔOI ratio output — agent must compute.

Gate 5 — Distribution flag (bullish-side OI closing): CITED, NOT DIRECTLY GATEABLE. uu oi decrease-with-volume returns closing contracts, but the agent must manually check whether the closing is on the bullish side of a long thesis (cross-ref with strike and option_type). No atomic 'distribution_flag' output from the CLI.

Gate 6 — Dividend-capture arb filter (ex-div names): CITED, DERIVABLE with external data. Spec (line 31, P1.4) filters 'deep-ITM sub-parity call sweeps near ex-div'. The CLI returns prices (via gex tool) and IV, but does not return ex-dividend dates; agent must fetch from yahoo-finance MCP or external calendar. Not gateable from CLI output alone.

DERIVED NUMERIC GATES: All thresholds (≥3 of 5, $50M cum_flow, 20% ΔOI, ask/bid ratio extremes) are either hardcoded in the spec or deterministic from tool output. No machine-learning or adaptive thresholds.
static.scope_discipline: Overlap vectors: (1) **sweep-tracker vs multileg-strategist**: both surface directional flow structures. Fence: sweep-tracker owns persistence-ranked single-day sweeps (narrative, 0 scoring post-P0.3); multileg owns coordinated multi-leg structures (trade-level) and gets the score if present. (2) **sweep-tracker vs accumulation-hunter**: both surface directional conviction. Fence: accumulation-hunter owns dark-pool block-stratified + OI-smart-positioning (3-signal conjunction, potential +3 scoring); sweep-tracker owns options-tape urgency (sweeps). A name can carry both tags without double-scoring (multileg or accumulation gets points, sweeps are narrative). (3) **sweep-tracker vs contrarian-scanner**: a crowded long can also be sweeping bullish. Fence (signal-confluence-quant.md C13): contrarian acknowledges the sweep contradiction in prose, applies the crowded-fade penalty OR the flow read, never both. No double-deduction. (4) **sweep-tracker vs uw historical cumulative-premium-flow**: the agent uses cum_flow_30d as an alignment-gate only (for mega-cap filter), never as standalone directional confirmation (signal-confluence-quant.md P1.4, P1.5 lines). This boundary is **cited and enforced in the rubric** — violation is an agent bug (misused as `+1 cumulative-premium-flow` line when it should be 0)."
static.scored_advisory_honesty: Agent mandates swept outcomes: (1) **Primary output is narrative, not scored**: "sweep-tracker still surfaces persistence-ranked sweeps in §3/§7 prose, but those names earn no points unless a multileg or accumulation co-flag is present." (sweep-tracker.md line 302, and signal-confluence-quant.md line 97). This is unambiguous — sweeps alone contribute 0 points; the agent prose is purely informational, feeding §2/§3/§7 of the daily report. (2) **OI-confirmed-opening is a routing flag, not a score gate**: "a sweep that is OI-confirmed-opening AND co-flagged by accumulation-hunter or multileg-strategist is a genuine opening build the quant can score through those tools (the sweep itself still earns 0 points)" (sweep-tracker.md line 33). The C4 gate (signal-confluence-quant.md line 66–69) caps `pre_risk_size` at half when opening is unconfirmed, but only for `bullish_flow` / `bearish_flow` classes — NOT for sweep-tracker candidacy. (3) **Mega-cap hedge-flow filter is ranking discipline, not scoring**: "the ranking discipline [is] kept because the agent's narrative output still feeds §2/§3/§7 of the report" (sweep-tracker.md line 31; emphasis added). The filter does not affect `raw_score`, only narrative ordering. No citation of inflated confidence is present — the agent correctly states this is an output-ordering rule to separate 'hedge flow' from 'directional.' (4) **Dividend-capture arb filter**: cites a specific example (NEE 2026-06-04 false-bullish) with explicit rationale (P1.4 audit). No overconfidence on sub-parity call sweeps — correctly frames them as 'arb, not conviction.'"
static.write_rule_present: Yes. Agent is read-only. Mandate states: "Output ranked by persistence count first, premium size second, with: ticker, direction, persistence count (N of 5), expiry targeted, cumulative premium, a one-line read on what the flow implies, and an explicit invalidation." No write or watchlist-mutation operations are assigned to sweep-tracker; all watchlist write-back is owned by `risk-monitor` (daily-analysis.md Step 2d, line 264). Agent must **not** invoke `uw watchlist manage` — this is a critical **read-only audit**, and sweep-tracker has no write mandate."
live_test_protocol: TEST 1 — Persistence count verification: Run `uw hot-chains sweep-persistence --json --quiet` and confirm the top-5 entries. Each must have a `sessions_in_top` field (integer 0–5). Verify at least 3 names exist with `sessions_in_top >= 3` (the agent's stated minimum for first-class signal). PASS/FAIL CRITERION: ≥3 names with sessions_in_top >= 3 exist in the result set; if fewer, the sweep-tracker narrative is entitled to surface only a stub (no first-class candidates) in §3.

TEST 2 — Single-day vs persistent divergence: Run `uw options-flow sweeps --json --quiet --top-n 10` and `uw hot-chains sweep-persistence --json --quiet` side-by-side. Extract the union of tickers from both. For each ticker, note: (a) whether it appears in the top-10 single-day sweeps; (b) whether it has `sessions_in_top >= 3` in persistence. Verify the sets DO NOT perfectly overlap. PASS/FAIL CRITERION: if single-day top-10 and persistence top-5 are identical (≥8-of-10 overlap), the agent's claim that 'persistence is the edge, not size' is contradicted by today's tape. (Historical precedent: 2026-05-19 tape showed NVDA/SPY/AAPL dominate both lists, but mid-cap names like HRMN appear in single-day only — divergence confirmed.)

TEST 3 — Ask/bid imbalance fields: Run `uw hot-chains smart-money-flow --json --quiet` and extract the first 5 records. For each, verify the presence of: `ask_side_volume`, `bid_side_volume`, `ask_bid_ratio`, `net_flow`. PASS/FAIL CRITERION: all four fields present in every record. Spot-check one record: compute `ask_bid_ratio` manually from ask/bid volumes to confirm the field's accuracy (field value should roughly match ask_side_volume / bid_side_volume, or its inverse for bid-side dominance).

TEST 4 — Mega-cap hedge-flow filter computability: Manually run the filter for one test name in the named mega-cap subset (e.g., NVDA or SPY). (a) Run `uw hot-chains sweep-persistence --symbol NVDA --json --quiet`; note the `dominant_direction` (bullish/bearish/mixed). (b) Run `uw historical cumulative-premium-flow --symbol NVDA --days 30 --json --quiet`; note the `net_flow` sign (positive = bullish, negative = bearish) and magnitude in dollars. (c) Check alignment: does sign(net_flow) match the sweep direction from (a)? Is |net_flow| >= $50M? PASS/FAIL CRITERION: the filter is computable from these two calls. If either call fails or returns null fields, the gate is NOT gateable. Record the result: e.g., 'NVDA: sweeps=bearish, cum_flow_30d=+$15.2B bullish, UNALIGNED → demote to hedge-flow watch' or 'AAPL: sweeps=mixed, cum_flow_30d=+$82.8M bullish, ALIGNED ✓ → no demotion'.

TEST 5 — OI-opening confirmation reproducibility: For a persistent sweep name (from TEST 1), run (a) `uw historical oi-trend --symbol <TICKER> --days 5 --json --quiet` and check the state field (should be BUILDING, FALLING, FLAT, or ROLLING_OFF). (b) Run `uw oi biggest-increases --symbol <TICKER> --json --quiet` and extract today's ΔOI from the result. (c) Run `uw options-flow sweeps --symbol <TICKER> --json --quiet` and estimate today's total volume. (d) Compute manually: is ΔOI >= 20% of day volume? PASS/FAIL CRITERION: the C4 gate is computable from these two/three tools. If oi-trend returns BUILDING or ΔOI meets threshold, tag `opening_confirmed: true`. If FALLING/FLAT and ΔOI < 20% of volume, tag `opening_confirmed: false`. The agent's spec (line 33) requires this tag on every surfaced name.

TEST 6 — Co-flag routing (accumulation or multileg): For the top persistence name from TEST 1, verify whether the same ticker appears in (a) accumulation-hunter's output (dark-pool block-stratified ≥ 3 signals aligned) OR (b) multileg-strategist's output (uw hot-chains multileg flagged). If either is true, the sweep is NOT solo and earns score potential through the co-flag tool. PASS/FAIL CRITERION: at least one sweep-tracker candidate (non-mega-cap) carries a co-flag; if none do, verify the report correctly notes them as narrative-only (0 scoring) per P0.3. This tests the gating discipline—that sweeps-alone do not score.

Likely interpretation: the trailing lookback window used by `uw historical pc-ratio-zscore` (default `--lookback-days 20`) implicitly includes past sessions, so if z-score is elevated AND was lower before, it's 'rising'. The tool `uw historical pc-ratio-zscore` documentation does not clarify whether it flags a *jump* (rising intraday) or a *sustained extreme* (high over the lookback window). Recommendation: agent should clarify whether 'rising' means session-over-session delta OR sustained elevation, and fetch historical z-scores if needed to verify the trend.

static.job_clarity: The agent's mandate is to "find high-conviction earnings trades and flag ones to avoid" by evaluating upcoming earnings plays over a ~14-day forward horizon. Specific scope: **PRE-EVENT vol trades** (BUY VOL / SELL VOL / CALENDAR / SKIP verdicts anchored to IV term-structure kink alignment and back-month skew confirmation). Secondary **POST-EVENT scope** (PEAD drift candidates) is explicitly withheld from scoring (advisory, 0 rubric points) pending backtest validation. The agent feeds two pathways: (a) rubric line `+1 in earnings-scout BUY VOL or SELL VOL` (Step 4 of daily-analysis.md, line 305) and (b) §5 (Volatility Surface) narrative in the report. Tools are called per-ticker on a candidate from the earnings-catalyst screener, not broadcast across all earnings in the market.

static_findings.title: expiry-heatmap lacks STRIKE dimension; agent cannot natively distinguish vertical from diagonal without external enrichment
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md line 9 says 'uw options-flow expiry-heatmap — same expiry across two strikes = vertical; different expiries = calendar/diagonal'. Tool output from `uw options-flow expiry-heatmap --symbol SPY --json` returns {expiry, total_premium_call, total_premium_put, total_volume_call, total_volume_put}. **NO STRIKE FIELD.** To detect a vertical (same expiry, two active strikes), agent must cross-reference with greek-screener or raw multileg contracts to find which strikes are active *within* an expiry. **LATENT INEFFICIENCY:** Agent must make ≥2 tool calls per ticker (expiry-heatmap + greek-screener + most-active) to infer structure, but spec lists them sequentially as if heatmap directly answers the vertical/calendar question. Spec should clarify: 'use heatmap to identify expiry concentration, then cross-ref with greek-screener/most-active to find strike-level activity.'

static_findings.title: greek-screener returns individual contracts without native STRIKE-level delta-skew aggregation; agent must compute delta range/asymmetry manually
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md line 10 says 'uw options-flow greek-screener — delta skew across strikes confirms structure (vertical narrows delta range, fly is delta-neutral, ratio is asymmetric)'. Tool returns {strike, delta, gamma, vega, premium, side, …} per contract. **No aggregation by strike or skew computation.** Agent must manually (a) group contracts by strike, (b) compute delta range per strike-grouping, (c) infer structure type (narrow range → vertical, neutral sum → fly, asymmetric → ratio). This is a *deterministic agent task* (not ambiguous), but it is **not native to the tool** — the spec assumes the tool provides 'delta skew' as a readable field. **EFFICIENCY NOTE:** Agent can derive this with O(n) post-processing, so not a blocker; but it is underspecified in the agent mandate.

PHASE C — Percentile-vs-raw-IV-rank alignment (Goyal-Saretto robustness check). C1. Pick one KINKED or BACKWARDATION name from Phase B. Run `uw historical iv-percentile-zscore --symbol <T> --lookback-days 252 --json --quiet` and capture: {percentile, zscore}. C2. Run `uw screener iv-rank --top-n 100 --mode high --json --quiet` and check where the Phase-B name ranks. Compare: (a) if percentile is ≥85 and iv-rank is top-20 → good alignment (both identify as extreme); (b) if percentile is ≥85 but iv-rank is top-50 → percentile is catching an outlier rank misses (agent should prefer percentile per line 10); (c) if percentile < 70 and iv-rank is top-20 → single-day IV spike (raw rank corrupted, percentile robust — agent call is correct). C3. Validate: agent line 10 states 'without Goyal-Saretto percentile, calls are weak.' Check whether the Phase-B name's win-rate (per signal-confluence-quant backtest) differs when scored on raw iv-rank vs iv-percentile-zscore. If win-rate increases when using percentile, percentile justifies the mandate.

PHASE D — VRP classification and bias assignment (mandatory gate validation). D1. Run `uw historical vrp --symbol SPY --date 2026-06-11 --json --quiet` and capture: {iv30, realised_sigma_30, vrp (iv30 − σ30), classification (positive/negative/neutral), bias_recommendation}. D2. For a BACKWARDATION SELL-VOL candidate from Phase B: confirm agent output includes `vrp_classification: 'positive'` (vol expensive vs realised). If VRP is negative (vol cheap), agent should either (a) not surface the SELL VOL candidate, or (b) surface with explicit caveat 'VRP-conflict: negative VRP, short-vol not recommended'. Check agent text for this gate. D3. For a KINKED-at-earnings candidate (from Phase B + Phase A B2): confirm agent output includes `catalyst: <earnings_date>` and tags the candidate as 'event-driven, sized for the move; hand off to earnings-scout' (per line 28). If VRP is positive (vol expensive) AND earnings event is pending, agent should still recommend the structure (KINKED earnings override VRP sign). Validate agent does NOT veto earnings-KINKED candidates based on VRP sign alone.

PHASE E — Panic-threshold gate on BACKWARDATION (front-end-iv-ratio discrimination). E1. Pick a BACKWARDATION ticker from Phase B. Run `uw options-structure front-end-iv-ratio --symbol <T> --near-dte 1 --far-dte 30 --date 2026-06-11 --json --quiet` and capture: {ratio, classification}. E2. If ratio > 1.10 AND it is **rising day-over-day** (requires prior-day call too): agent should flag 'event still pending, do not fade' per line 34. Confirm agent does NOT surface this name as a calendar-spread candidate. E3. If ratio > 1.05 but ≤ 1.10 AND it is **falling** (or flat): agent should surface as calendar candidate per line 29. Confirm agent text includes 'panic resolving' logic.

PHASE F — Single-contract IV outliers (whale-hedge detection). F1. Run `uw options-flow iv-outliers --symbol SPY --min-iv 1.5 --min-volume 50 --json --quiet` and capture top-3 results: {ticker, strike, expiry, iv, volume}. F2. For each outlier, run `uw historical iv-percentile-zscore --symbol <T> --lookback-days 252 --json --quiet` to check if the outlier's IV is ≥2σ above percentile (whale hedge misprice). Confirm agent surfaces extreme-IV single contracts in prose (line 30: 'Single-contract iv-outliers (potential whale-hedge mispricings)').

PHASE G — Earnings alignment and routing (C13 mutual exclusivity gate). G1. Run `uw screener earnings-catalyst --days-until-earnings 14 --min-iv-rank 50 --json --quiet` and get 3–5 candidates with pending earnings in the next 14 days. G2. For each earnings candidate, run `uw options-structure iv-term-structure --symbol <T> --json --quiet` and check structure: (a) if KINKED and kink_expiry matches earnings date → agent should flag 'KINKED with catalyst alignment (event-driven, sized for the move; hand off to earnings-scout)' and award **signal-confluence-quant +1 vol-surface line, but NOT also score earnings-scout's earnings_vol line** (C13 routing: earnings-scout owns it). Validate the agent output includes handoff language; (b) if KINKED but NO earnings date match → clean calendar play if front-end-iv-ratio is falling.

PHASE H — Liquidity floor enforcement (C12 upstream gate check). H1. Check whether the Phase 0 Step 0 context (passed to agent via daily-analysis orchestrator) includes a pre-floored candidate list. If so, agent receives already-filtered names and does not need to re-check. If agent is invoked standalone (outside daily-analysis pipeline), confirm agent applies C12 floor: price ≥ $5 AND 20-day dollar-ADV ≥ $50M before output.

PHASE I — Output schema and mandatory fields validation (per agent line 17–25). I1. Run a live daily-analysis report (post-market, 2026-06-11 or later) and inspect vol-surface-scout's output block in the JSON envelope. Confirm every candidate includes: ticker, structure (KINKED/BACKWARDATION/CONTANGO), kink_expiry (if applicable), iv_percentile_zscore (with percentile + zscore fields), iv_rank (raw, sanity check), vrp_classification (positive/negative/neutral), front_end_iv_ratio + panic_call, catalyst (earnings date or 'no catalyst'), bias (BUY VOL / SELL VOL / CALENDAR), trade (specific structure, strikes, expiries), invalidation (explicit kill condition). I2. Check the three output buckets (line 27–30): (a) KINKED-with-catalyst bucket populated? (b) BACKWARDATION-with-no-catalyst bucket has front-end-iv-ratio falling? (c) Single-contract outliers tagged with whale signature?

PHASE J — Win-rate validation and scoring confirmation (signal-confluence-quant integration check). J1. In the decision.json envelope (daily-analysis Step 2d output), find every vol-surface-scout-flagged candidate and confirm signal-confluence-quant assigned it a score_component: `{rubric_line: '+1 in vol-surface-scout KINKED or BACKWARDATION watch with VRP-aligned bias', points: 1, source_agent: 'vol-surface-scout', source_tool: 'uw options-structure iv-term-structure', evidence: '<VRP classification + structure + reason>'}`. If a vol-surface-scout candidate received +1, confirm: (a) VRP alignment is stated in evidence (positive VRP for SELL VOL / calendar; negative VRP for BUY VOL or earnings-event override); (b) structure (KINKED/BACKWARDATION/CONTANGO) matches the tool output; (c) no double-scoring via multileg or earnings-scout (C13 mutual-exclusivity gate enforced). J2. Check win-rate on vol-surface-scout signal class across recent runs (last 10 daily reports, if available in `/calibration-audit` checkpoints): is vol_realisation_rate ≥ 0.50? If < 0.50, signal is not edge and sizing should cap at 'starter' (per signal-confluence-quant sizing-map line 37–41).

EDGE CASE — VRP-KINKED earnings override logic verification. V1. Create a test case: ticker has KINKED structure at an upcoming earnings date. Run on two different VRP regimes: (a) positive VRP (vol expensive, short-vol favored), (b) negative VRP (vol cheap, long-vol favored). In case (a), agent should recommend SELL VOL on the KINKED earnings (event premium, not term-structure premium). In case (b), agent should recommend BUY VOL or stand aside (event risk + cheap vol = no edge). Validate agent text handles both scenarios.

Expected: dark-pool returns block trades (premium, timestamp, size); sweeps returns aggressive contracts (side ask/bid, trade_count). SUCCESS: Dark-pool readable as positioning tells; sweeps carry directional urgency (repeated same-side trades); inflow ETF net_flow > 0 aligns with inflow classification; outflow ETF net_flow < 0 aligns with outflow classification. Graceful-skip if <3 results (thin ETF). No command errors.

Test 4: GICS-ETF Cross-Confirmation. From Test 1, identify highest-persistence sector (e.g., Technology with persistence=1.0). Map to canonical ETF via line 36 map (XLK). From Test 2, determine XLK net_flow sign. COMPARE: Does XLK net_flow sign AGREE with sector trend? If sector INFLOW (persistence_score ≥0.6, trend=INFLOW) AND XLK net_flow > 0, set gics_agreement='agree' (HIGH-CONVICTION). If opposite (sector INFLOW, XLK net_flow < 0), set 'disagree' (DOWNGRADE). Test 5: Sector-Level Institutional-vs-Retail Share Inference. Run uw options-flow dte-volume-share --json --quiet. Expected: market-level share_0dte, share_weeklies, share_monthlies, share_leaps. All quoted report numbers reproduce exactly (XLP +7,566,885, XLU −4,493,468, SMH −151,556,452, CC −325,924,919, Tech 3,796,276,879→2,126,197,245). The agent's no_change/low-confidence regime call is what the raw data supports.

verdict.reasoning: (a) Real edge: the agent's job is unique in the fleet — no overlap pair touches sector rotation, regime detection, or leader extraction (risk-monitor consumes sector data but does not own the thesis), so MERGE/REMOVE are off the table. But the claimed PRIMARY edge (persistence_score >= 0.6 gate) did not bind live: 2026-06-11 returned 11/11 sectors >= 0.6 with 9 at the 1.0 ceiling, because net_flow = call-minus-put premium is positive market-wide nearly every day (Tech 06-11: $8.08B calls vs $5.95B puts) — the gate filtered nothing. The discrimination that DID materialize came from layered deltas the agent stacks on top (Consumer Cyclical ROTATING −$326M vs +$89M, Tech decel $3.8B→$2.1B, SMH −151.6M BEARISH), all verified exact against raw recomputation. The rubric's own Phase 4 note (daily-analysis line 304) concedes sector_persistence standalone is NO-INFO (+2.8pp); only the conjunction with cum_flow alignment discriminated, on an n=2 anecdote (HON-W21 vs WMT-W19). (b) Does its job: yes, honestly — tonight it output rotation_regime no_change at low confidence and awarded zero scored points when no canonical pattern existed; precision check was exact on every quoted number. One factual miss: report claimed Utilities "both layers agree" rotating-out while the primary persistence tool shows ps=0.8 INFLOW — agreement held only vs the single-day snapshot its own hard rule (lines 8/27) excludes. (c) Precision defects are concrete and named: stale integer-scale thresholds survive in the invalidation spec (line 51 "drops below 2" — always true on a 0–1 scale, same bug class as the fixed 2026-05-25 entry gate) and output spec (line 45 "Persistence >= 3 only"); dte-volume-share is market-level only, making institutional_share and the 0DTE>50% disqualifier non-derivable despite line 13 and daily-analysis line 131 claiming per-sector data; rubric gate (b) "direction aligned" is ambiguous between sign(net_flow) and trend_direction (MU: +$312M net = 0.33% of $46.9B gross, tool says MIXED — passes one reading, fails the other); etf_flow_tape[].persistence (line 39 rank formula) is not computable from cumulative-premium-flow (no per-day series), so tonight substituted the categorical label; GICS-vs-ETF agreement disagreed 4-of-4 sampled pairs with ~100–1000x magnitude mismatch, suggesting the agreement lane is structurally biased toward disagree (call-skewed single-name aggregate vs hedge-skewed ETF options). No live mis-scoring occurred (envelope awarded no sector +1), so these are spec/gate defects, not active calibration leaks — salvageable with targeted edits, hence FIX not REMOVE.
verdict.edge_assessment: UNTESTED — the only scored contribution (conditional +1, daily-analysis line 304) rests on an n=2 anecdote (HON win / WMT loss) and its persistence leg is demonstrably non-discriminative live (11/11 sectors pass, 9 at ceiling; the leg alone is near-ILLUSORY as a filter in a bull tape). The conjunction with cum_flow alignment plausibly carries real content but has never been backtested across regimes, and the magnitude gate is satisfiable by noise (MU +$312M = 0.33% of gross, trend MIXED). The agent's advisory layers (ROTATING-trend deltas, ETF tape deceleration) showed genuine discrimination tonight, but none of that is the registered edge. Not DOUBLE-COUNTED: leader names feed the swing book under an existing conditional +1 with an explicit "no new points" fence that held live.
top_fixes: Purge the two stale integer-scale remnants (same bug class as the 2026-05-25 entry-gate fix): agent line 51 invalidation 'drops below 2 for >=2 sessions' -> 'drops below 0.6 for >=2 sessions', and line 45 'Persistence >=3 only' -> 'persistence_score >= 0.6 only'. Impact: the invalidation trigger becomes satisfiable/meaningful instead of vacuously always-true, restoring a real exit condition for live rotation calls.

De-degenerate the persistence gate: keep the 0–1 scale but make it market-relative — score sign-consistency of (sector net_flow minus cross-sector median net_flow) or additionally require the sector rank in the top/bottom 3 by net_flow. Impact: in a tape where call-minus-put premium is positive everywhere (tonight: 11/11 sectors >=0.6), the gate would again filter, restoring selectivity to the conditional +1 it feeds.

Fix the dte-volume-share overclaim: the tool is market-level only ({symbol: MARKET}), so either (i) rewrite agent line 13, output field institutional_share (line 45), the 0DTE>50% disqualifier (line 56), and daily-analysis line 131 to the explicit sweeps-expiry-distribution inference the static auditor invented, written into the file as the actual method, or (ii) drop the per-sector institutional/0DTE claims entirely. Impact: removes a non-derivable output field and an unenforceable disqualifier; closes the gap where the static audit PASSed a gate on a rationalization.

Disambiguate rubric gate (b) and tighten gate (c) at daily-analysis line 304: define 'direction aligned' as the tool's trend_direction field (BULLISH/BEARISH matching thesis; MIXED fails) rather than sign(net_flow), and add a net/gross ratio floor (e.g. |net_flow|/(bullish+bearish gross) >= 2%) so $50M cannot be satisfied by 0.33%-of-gross noise like MU 06-11. Impact: the agent's only scored point becomes deterministic and noise-resistant; also resolves the etf_flow_tape persistence column by formally accepting the categorical trend_direction as the spec'd field.
